title: The tutorial's hooks pass the runtime
body: Since engine pass B, both hook handles need `{ runtime }`. A bare call is a type error, and `devBackendHandle()` throws at startup because it reads `config.content`. The tutorial already exports `runtime` from `src/lib/cairn.server.ts`, so the hooks block imports it and passes it to both handles. No step was added.
now: handle = devBackendHandle({ runtime }); ... handle = createAuthGuard({ runtime });

title: The hooks file needs no edit
body: The section had the reader import the map into the hooks file and pass `{ roles, access }` to both handles. Both handles now read the map from the runtime, so the section's one step declares `roles` and `access` on the adapter. Three steps came out, and the heading drops "and the guard".
The page also stops describing a scaffold signups screen. It lives only in `examples/showcase`, and the verify steps now open the reader's own gated route.
was: Pass the map to the adapter and the guard (four steps)
now: Pass the map to the adapter (one step)

title: The access-map refusal's cause moved
body: The page said the dev backend attaches the access map only when given `{ access }`. It now attaches `runtime.access ?? {}` wherever it sets the editor (`handle.ts:192`), as the guard does. The refusal now comes only from a site's own hook that sets `locals.cairnEditor` without `locals.cairnAccess`. The `sveltekit.md` and `log-events.md` rows say the same.
was: Fix: pass the map as devBackendHandle({ access }).
now: Fix: that hook also sets locals.cairnAccess, or the route goes behind the guard.

title: The tree matches what the scaffold ships
body: The page still listed the signups demo the scaffold dropped: `migrations-app/`, a second D1 database, and an `admin/signups/` route. All three are gone, and the page says the site binds one D1 database. It also lists `0001_roles.sql`, which the scaffold ships, and `+error.svelte` in the admin route tree.
These last edits were the session's, checked against the `templates/waymark` listing and `f:gepykz`, without another agent round.
was: two D1 databases; 0001_roles.sql opt-in and absent
